info.name: AlgoVault API
info.description:
Updated to match real implementation as of Task 13. Response envelope is {ok:true, data, meta?} on success, {ok:false, error:{code, message, details?}} on failure.

Import and set the `baseUrl` and `accessToken` collection variables. `accessToken` is auto-set by the Login request's test script.

Stub routes (return placeholder data):
  - GET /cf/stats
  - GET /notes/:id/versions
  - GET /search

Auth note: POST /auth/refresh reads the __refresh__ httpOnly cookie set by login/register — no body or header needed.

item.name: Register
item.description: Required: email (valid email), password (min 8 chars), displayName (2-60 chars). Rate-limited: 20 req / 15 min. Response: { user, accessToken }. refreshToken set as httpOnly cookie.

item.name: Login
item.description: Required: email, password. Rate-limited: 20 req / 15 min. Sets accessToken collection variable via test script.

item.name: Refresh
item.description: No body or Authorization header needed. Reads __refresh__ httpOnly cookie. Returns new accessToken + rotated refresh cookie.

item.name: Logout
item.description: Revokes all refresh sessions for the user. Clears httpOnly cookie.

item.name: Me
item.description: Returns current user. Response: { user: { id, email, displayName, role, cfHandle, createdAt } }

item.name: List Notes
item.description: Returns paginated list of caller's notes. Query params: page, limit, visibility, patternTags. Response: { items, total, page, limit }

item.name: Create Note
item.description: Required: title. Optional: contentMarkdown (sanitized server-side), codeBlocks (array), problemId, patternTags (array), visibility ('public'|'private'), confidence (1-5). Response: NoteDTO

item.name: Get Note
item.description: Returns note if caller is owner or note is public. Currently a stub.

item.name: Update Note (autosave)
item.description: Partial update. Owner-only. Rate-limited: 15 req / 10 s (autosave bucket). contentMarkdown is sanitized server-side. Response: updated NoteDTO

item.name: Delete Note (soft)
item.description: Soft-deletes the note. Owner-only. Response: deleted NoteDTO

item.name: Fork Note
item.description: Creates a copy of the note for the caller. Works on deleted notes. Caller must have read access. Response 201: new NoteDTO with forkOf set.

item.name: Note Versions (stub)
item.description: STUB — always returns { versions: [] }. Owner-only.

item.name: Report Note
item.description: File a report on a note. Caller must have read access. Required: reason (non-empty string). Response 201: { id, reporterId, targetType, targetId, reason, status, createdAt, updatedAt }

item.name: Resolve Problem URL
item.description: Resolves and caches problem metadata. Required: url. Rate-limited: 15 req / 60 s. Response: ProblemDTO { id, platform, externalId, title, url, difficulty, tags, fetchedAt }

item.name: Enroll Note
item.description: Enrolls a note in SM-2 spaced-repetition. Required: noteId. Response: RevisionDTO { id, userId, noteId, repetitions, intervalDays, easeFactor, lastReviewedAt, nextReviewAt }

item.name: Due Today
item.description: Returns revisions with nextReviewAt <= now. Response: { items: RevisionDTO[], count }

item.name: Submit Review
item.description: Applies SM-2 algorithm. Required: rating (0-3 integer). Response: updated RevisionDTO.

item.name: Revision Stats
item.description: Response: { dueToday, reviewedToday, retention7d } — retention7d is the pass rate (rating >= 2) over reviews from the last 7 days, 0 if none.

item.name: List Sheets
item.description: All non-deleted sheets owned by caller. Response: { items: SheetDTO[], total }

item.name: Create Sheet
item.description: Required: title. Optional: description, visibility, targetDate, items[]. Response 201: SheetDTO

item.name: Get Sheet
item.description: Caller must be owner or sheet is public. Response: SheetDTO { id, ownerId, title, description, visibility, targetDate, items[], forkOf, forkCount, progressPct, createdAt, updatedAt }

item.name: Update Sheet
item.description: Partial update of sheet metadata. Owner-only. Response: updated SheetDTO.

item.name: Delete Sheet (soft)
item.description: Soft-deletes the sheet. Owner-only. Response: deleted SheetDTO.

item.name: Update Sheet Item Status
item.description: Owner-only. Optional fields: status ('todo'|'in_progress'|'done'), title, problemId, position. Response: full SheetDTO with updated item.

item.name: Fork Sheet
item.description: Creates a copy for the caller. Caller needs read access. Response 201: new SheetDTO with forkOf set.

item.name: Report Sheet
item.description: File a report on a sheet. Caller must have read access. Required: reason (non-empty string). Response 201: { id, reporterId, targetType, targetId, reason, status, createdAt, updatedAt }

item.name: CF Sync
item.description: Syncs Codeforces stats. Required: handle. Rate-limited: 15 req / 60 s. Response: CfStatsDTO { handle, currentRating, maxRating, ratingHistory, solvedByTag, syncedAt }

item.name: CF Stats (stub)
item.description: STUB — returns mock CF stats. Real implementation pending.

item.name: Dashboard Summary
item.description: Returns dashboard aggregations: patternCounts, difficultyDistribution, streak, stalenessAlerts.

item.name: Search (stub)
item.description: STUB — returns { query: '...', results: [] }. When implemented, ?q= will be the search term.

item.name: List Tags
item.description: Admin-only. Response: { tags: string[] }

item.name: Create Tag
item.description: Admin-only. Required: tag (non-empty string). Stored lowercase. Returns 409 if tag exists. Response 201: { tag: string }

item.name: Delete Tag
item.description: Admin-only. :id is the tag NAME (not a UUID). Response: { deleted: true }

item.name: List Reports
item.description: Admin-only. Returns all open reports. Response: { reports: [{ id, reporterId, reporter: {id,email,displayName}, targetType, targetId, reason, status, createdAt, updatedAt, targetDetails: {title, ownerId} }] }

item.name: Resolve Report
item.description: Admin-only. Required: status — must be exactly 'resolved' or 'dismissed'. Response: { id, reporterId, targetType, targetId, reason, status, createdAt, updatedAt }

item.name: Health Check
item.description: No auth required. Response: { status: 'up', ts: <epoch_ms> }
